metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of muscle pain and tightness in rear (posterior) thigh area.

This video will show how to relieve strain to muscles commonly associated with pains and aches around the back of the thigh. This includes the hamstrings.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix your back thigh pain!
